Generic prefab cabin images (white/blue corrugated steel, standard door and windows) are insufficient to confirm smoking cabin identity without visible exhaust, ventilation, or ashtray features.

reason: Smoking cabins are structural enclosures whose key buyer-relevant attributes (exhaust duct placement, glass panels, ashtray integration, ventilation grilles) are visible in the product appearance itself — OCR cannot extract these from the image.

The one confirmed good product image (69171064) shows the product from a front/perspective angle where structural and functional features are the information — no printed text labels on the product surface carry spec data.
Generic prefab cabin images (which dominate the bad products) confirm that product appearance IS the differentiator — a smoking cabin must visually show smoking-specific features to be buyer-useful.
